messages.subject: Project Yarrow — ready for signature
messages.plaintextBody:
Helena, Grace,

We and Pemberton Rowe have agreed all open points. The execution version of the LTSA is final (cap at 135%, 6-week trigger, 20% shortfall with certification-delay relief, 5% escalation cap with carbon-fibre pass-through). Subject to Friday's board approval, we propose to exchange counterparts by email on 14 January, with each side's solicitors holding the signed signature pages to order.

Please arrange for Robert (or another director) to sign the signature page we'll circulate.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
